items.raw_excerpt: Booth-level officers streamline electoral notice distribution through group hearings, reducing crowding and maximizing efficiency in Hyderabad's localities.
items.summary_en: Booth-level officers in Hyderabad are conducting group hearings locality-wise to distribute electoral notices more efficiently. The approach reduces crowding at polling stations and speeds up the process for residents. Local officials handle the bulk of the work to keep things running smoothly.

items.title_en: Hyderabad BLOs streamline notice distribution with group hearings
items.title_ko: 히드라바드 BLO, 구역별 단체 청문으로 선거 통지 배부 간소화
items.title_original: BLOs do the heavy lifting; group hearings to be conducted locality wise

items.raw_excerpt: A south Auckland community hub is being shut down by its landlord Kainga Ora, despite those involved in the hub saying it has helped make the neighbourhood a better place.
items.summary_en: A community hub in south Auckland is being closed by its landlord Kainga Ora. People involved say the hub has helped make the neighbourhood a better place.

items.raw_excerpt: La destacada deportista del Team ParaChile recibió la noticia a través de una videollamada del ministro del Deporte.

items.summary_en: Harikatha performers in Andhra Pradesh are asking the government for funding and help to keep the traditional storytelling art alive. They want to use large temple programs to bring young people into the art form.

items.raw_excerpt: Anchoring the pulse of Avenida da Liberdade, the historic Cinema São Jorge served as the vibrant home for the second edition of the Worten Mock Fest – Festival Internacional de Comédia, which ran its final acts through 30 August.
items.summary_en: The second Worten Mock Fest comedy festival finished its final shows at Cinema São Jorge on Avenida da Liberdade. The historic Lisbon venue hosted international comedians for the event running through 30 August.

items.raw_excerpt: Parents have been warned to on the lookout for Rotavirus.
items.summary_en: South Africa's National Institute for Communicable Diseases has warned parents about a rise in Rotavirus cases in Pretoria. Rotavirus is a common virus that causes severe diarrhea in young children. Health officials are urging parents to watch for symptoms and seek medical care early.
items.summary_ko: 남아공 국립감염병연구소(NICD)가 프리토리아 지역의 로타바이러스 환자가 늘고 있다며 부모들의 주의를 당부했다. 로타바이러스는 영유아에게 심한 설사를 유발하는 흔한 바이러스다. 보건 당국은 증상을 잘 살펴보고 초기에 진료를 받을 것을 권고하고 있다.
items.title_en: South Africa health institute warns parents as Rotavirus cases rise in Pretoria

items.title_original: NICD warns parents as Rotavirus cases rise in Pretoria

items.raw_excerpt: Temporal provocou rajadas de vento de até 81 km/h e ocorrências pontuais
items.summary_en: Heavy rain hit Curitiba, Brazil, bringing strong winds up to 81 km/h. The storm caused street flooding, soil erosion, and some homes lost their roof tiles. No serious injuries were reported.

items.title_en: Heavy rain causes flooding and roof damage in Curitiba

items.summary_en: Governor Samuel García announced two new bridges at the Colombia-Laredo Port of Entry. He also plans a viaduct to connect Monterrey's industrial zone with Anáhuac and Nuevo Laredo.

items.raw_excerpt: The 2026 kākāpō breeding season, the biggest on record, has come to an end with a bumper number of kākāpō chicks produced. The youngest chick has just passed 150 days old, a milestone that marks its independence.
items.summary_en: The 2026 kakapo breeding season has ended, the biggest on record. A bumper number of kakapo chicks were produced. The youngest chick has just passed 150 days old, a milestone marking its independence.

items.raw_excerpt: La competencia disputada en Paine convocó a representantes de más de 15 nacionalidades y tuvo a Patricio Farías y Liceth Gaitán como ganadores de su categoría principal.
items.summary_en: A mountain bike competition in Paine, Chile brought together riders from more than 15 countries. Patricio Farías and Liceth Gaitán won the main category titles. The race honors the legacy of Chilean endurance athlete Carlo de Gavardo.

items.raw_excerpt: A ship is set to leave the Port of Churchill this week loaded with what would be the northern Manitoba town's first grain shipment in over half a decade.
items.summary_en: A ship leaves the Port of Churchill loaded with grain. This marks the first grain shipment from the northern Manitoba town in over five years. The port had been closed for grain exports since 2017.

items.summary_en: Ricardo Seguel and Emilia Veloso won the national sailing qualifier at the Copa Escuela Naval BCI. The young sailors will represent Chile at the Sunfish World Championship in the Virgin Islands this November.

items.raw_excerpt: Canada's last captive whales are set to leave the country today as the six belugas from Marineland are headed to two aquariums in the United States.
items.summary_en: Six beluga whales from Marineland in Niagara Falls, Ontario are leaving Canada for two aquariums in the United States. They are the last captive whales in Canada. Their departure marks the end of whale captivity in the country.

items.title_en: Canada's last captive whales leave Marineland for U.S. aquariums

items.title_original: Canada's last captive whales are set to leave Niagara Falls, Ont., Marineland for U.S. aquariums

items.raw_excerpt: Colossal Biosciences calls itself an advanced genetics company that's developing the science that will save us all.
items.summary_en: A New Zealand genetics company wants to use science to bring back the moa, a giant bird that disappeared long ago. Scientists debate if de-extinction is possible and if it is right to do. The moa once roamed New Zealand forests before humans arrived.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드의 한 유전학 회사가 오래전 사라진 거대한 새인 모아를 과학으로 되살리는 기술을 개발하고 있다. 과학자들은 멸종된 동물을 되살리는 것이 가능한지, 그리고 옳은 일인지 논쟁하고 있다. 모아는 인간이 뉴질랜드에 도착하기 전 숲을 누비던 새였다.
items.title_en: Should we bring back the moa?
items.title_ko: 모아를 되살릴 수 있을까, 그리고 그래야 할까?
items.title_original: Can we de-extinct the moa and more importantly, should we?

items.raw_excerpt: La velocista chilena registró 50,39 segundos en el Grand Prix de Brescia, competencia que reunió a destacadas figuras internacionales.
items.summary_en: Chilean sprinter Martina Weil ran her fastest 400 meters of the season. She finished in 50.39 seconds at the Grand Prix in Brescia. The race featured many top international runners.
